beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some of the religious leaders came to Jesus with a complaint. They had seen his disciples eating with unwashed hands — breaking not God's law, but a tradition the elders had added on top of it. To them, that was a scandal.

timing.text: Some of the religious leaders came to Jesus with a complaint.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus was not impressed by the show. He answered them with words the prophet Isaiah had written long before.

timing.text: Jesus was not impressed by the show.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me. Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

timing.text: This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You can say every right word and keep every custom and still be a thousand miles away on the inside. He was never counting the handwashing. He was looking for what stood behind it.

timing.text: You can say every right word and keep every custom and still be a thousand miles away on the inside.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men.

timing.text: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then he gave them an example that exposed the whole game. God had said, Honour thy father and thy mother. But their custom let a man label his money a gift promised to the temple — and use that label as an excuse to give nothing to his own aging parents.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered.

timing.text: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They had used a rule about God to cancel a command from God — turning devotion into a loophole. That was his warning: never let the outside of religion grow so loud that it drowns out the heart of it. He would always rather have an honest heart than a flawless performance. Come to him with the real one.
